body:
> This is likely because TextureRect implements repeat using `draw_texture_rect()` instead of `draw_rect_region()` like Sprite2D does.

Yeah, it happends because `RendererCanvasCull::canvas_item_add_texture_rect` with `p_tile = true` force sets repeat flag to `CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_REPEAT_ENABLED` (that's why a tiling TextureRect still repeats just fine even with its `texture_filter = TEXTURE_REPEAT_DISABLED`):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed/servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp#L1522-L1526

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed/drivers/gles3/rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp#L936-L939
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_canvas_render_rd.cpp#L2406-L2409
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed/servers/rendering_server.h#L916-L922

---

So what's kinda questionable here is the behavior of `RendererCanvasCull::canvas_item_add_texture_rect` with `p_tile = true`. I guess a viable option would be changing it so it would force `CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_REPEAT_ENABLED` only if the canvas item's repeat is different than `CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_REPEAT_MIRROR`? 🤔 So if the canvas item's repeat is `CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_REPEAT_MIRROR`, it would preserve it.
